BEFORE YOU SET OUT

A little clarity.
A better climb.

Everything you need to prepare for your Ooty expedition.

View the official listing ↗
When and where is OOTY HACKS?+

OOTY HACKS takes place offline on 19–20 December 2026 in Ooty, The Nilgiris, Tamil Nadu. The exact venue and reporting time will be announced.

How many people can be on a team?+

Teams can have 1–4 members. You can register as a solo participant or bring your team.

What is the registration fee?+

The registration fee is ₹1,000 per team. Complete your registration through the official OOTY HACKS listing on Unstop.

Can we choose our problem statement?+

There are two classified missions. Each team receives one mission at the start of the hackathon and has 24 hours to build. A surprise challenge is introduced at the 12th hour.

What should we bring?+

Bring your laptop, charger, necessary adapters, and warm clothing for Ooty. Check the official listing for final reporting instructions and any required documents before travelling.

What opportunities are included?+

The event features a ₹1 lakh prize pool, mentorship, networking, AI credits, goodies, swags, certificates, and career opportunities. Internship and pre-placement offers depend on partner selection; detailed benefits and prize distribution will be announced.
